meta.title: Reviewed foundation design: Auth adapter trust boundary

components.label: Managed Auth users / sessions
components.sublabel: SELECT only; no business table access

cards.title: Authentication-only elevation
items: The fixed adapter is the sole postgres-owned authentication exception.
It requires authenticator session provenance and the authenticated request role.
It checks claim types, expiry, audience and the matching live Auth user/session.
No identity arguments, business reads, mutations, tokens or session rows are returned.

cards.title: Business authorization remains separate
items: API wrappers are invokers; private business helpers and commands keep non-bypass owners.
Active membership, assigned shops and owner-only ordinary price authority remain database checks.
Custom roles cannot log in, assume managed roles, access Auth tables, or own business tables.

cards.title: Scope and evidence
items: Approved design description; this is not a repository-revision provenance claim.
Only Fire_Inv mjtejwafxriwntweussc is authorized for hosted foundation proofs.
Operator/admin credentials remain outside Next.js and the browser.
